FIELDS.NAME: The Book Nook
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
The Book Nook operates as a retail bookstore, offering a curated selection of new and lightly used books across various genres, aiming to provide a comfortable and inviting atmosphere for customers. We prioritize the organization of our store, ensuring clear and well-lit aisleways to minimize any risks of slip-and-fall accidents. Our team conducts regular inventory assessments to maintain accurate valuation and coverage of our inventory, including scheduling our high-value items for insurance purposes. We maintain a premium customer service experience, offering community events such as book signings and readings, ensuring proper liability coverage for these activities. Additionally, our store is equipped with both a basic theft prevention system and fire safety measures, safeguarding our inventory and providing a secure environment for our customers and staff.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not operate as an adult bookstore or used bookstore and confirms that it adheres to standard business hours, avoiding 24-hour or late-night operations. Additionally, we ensure that any high-value or rare inventory is properly scheduled and appraised as required.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 20, 2022, The Book Nook experienced water damage due to a burst pipe, resulting in $5,000 in losses related to inventory and repairs. The situation was promptly addressed, and all damaged goods were documented and disposed of. The status of this loss is considered resolved, with necessary repairs completed. Additionally, in January 2023, the bookstore faced minor theft incidents, totaling $2,500 in losses, which were also reported to authorities and followed by enhanced security measures to prevent future occurrences. This loss is also marked as resolved.
FIELDS.Bodily Injury & Prop Damage Occurrrence: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate with a $2,500 deductible.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Steel vault; Grade III; Security label A.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras and a nightly security guard to monitor the premises outside of operational hours.
